description: Coordinator purity violation (Stage 5 report, Tim Rayburn 2026-10-07): systems/ies-channel/ies-channel.py line 145 ran subprocess.run(["which", "claude"], ...), CLI shell execution inside the daemon that boots the IES agent. Resolving the interpreter path does not require spawning a shell; the subprocess call put shell execution on the coordinator's path.
correction: Replaced the subprocess.run(["which", "claude"]) call with shutil.which("claude"): pure-Python PATH resolution, no shell execution. Added an import shutil and a comment marking find_claude() as harness bootstrap (daemon startup infrastructure), explicitly outside coordinator task execution.
systemic_fix: ies-channel.py find_claude() now resolves the claude binary via shutil.which with the Homebrew path as fallback, and is documented as harness bootstrap rather than a coordinator-executed task. No shell subprocess remains in the capability-check path.
